svg.style: background: transparent; background-color: transparent; color-scheme: light dark;

<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="T_Txx3Xaxb4ICrfqFrLV"> <mxGraphModel dx="857" dy="-603" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml
skinparam actorStyle awesome
skinparam packageStyle rectangle
skinparam usecase {
 BackgroundColor #EEF4FF
 BorderColor #3A6BD4
 FontColor #1A2235
 FontSize 11
}
skinparam actor {
 BackgroundColor #D6E4FF
 BorderColor #1D4ED8
 FontColor #1A2235
 FontSize 12
 FontStyle bold
}
skinparam package {
 BackgroundColor #F8FBFF
 BorderColor #93B4E8
 FontColor #1A2235
 FontStyle bold
}
skinparam arrow {
 Color #3A6BD4
 FontColor #3A6BD4
 FontSize 10
}

left to right direction

actor \"Admin\" as Admin #LightSteelBlue

rectangle \"AI-Driven Smart LMS — Admin Portal\" {

 package \"Authentication\" {
 usecase \"Login\" as UC_Login
 usecase \"Update Profile\" as UC_Profile
 }

 package \"User Management\" {
 usecase \"Create / Edit\nStudents & Teachers\" as UC_Users
 usecase \"Activate / Deactivate\nUser Account\" as UC_Toggle
 usecase \"Enroll Student\nFace (Dlib)\" as UC_Face
 }

 package \"Academic Structure\" {
 usecase \"Manage Departments\n& Programs\" as UC_Dept
 usecase \"Manage Courses\n& CLOs\" as UC_Course
 usecase \"Manage Semesters\n& Offerings\" as UC_Sem
 }

 package \"Enrollment Management\" {
 usecase \"Enroll Student\nin Program & Courses\" as UC_Enroll
 usecase \"Drop Enrollment\n& Enter Grades\" as UC_Drop
 }

 package \"Attendance Management\" {
 usecase \"View Attendance\nReports\" as UC_AttRpt
 usecase \"View Campus Gate\nAttendance\" as UC_GateAtt
 usecase \"Manual Attendance\nOverride\" as UC_Override
 }

 package \"Fee Management\" {
 usecase \"Define Fee\nStructure\" as UC_FeeStr
 usecase \"Generate Fee\nVouchers (Bulk)\" as UC_Voucher
 usecase \"Record Payment\n& Apply Fine\" as UC_Payment
 }

 package \"Campus Gate Management\" {
 usecase \"Manage Gates\n& Cameras\" as UC_Gates
 usecase \"Set Gate\nSchedules\" as UC_Sched
 usecase \"Operate Gate\nFace Scanner\" as UC_Scanner
 }

 package \"Communication\" {
 usecase \"Post Announcements\n& Notices\" as UC_Ann
 }

 package \"AI Analytics\" {
 usecase \"Calculate & View\nStudent Analytics\" as UC_Analytics
 usecase \"View Leaderboard\n& At-Risk Students\" as UC_Leader
 }

 package \"Chatbot & API Keys\" {
 usecase \"Manage Chatbot\nFAQs\" as UC_FAQ
 usecase \"Manage Gemini\nAPI Keys\" as UC_Keys
 }
}

' ── Associations ─────────────────────────────────
Admin --> UC_Login
Admin --> UC_Profile

Admin --> UC_Users
Admin --> UC_Toggle
Admin --> UC_Face

Admin --> UC_Dept
Admin --> UC_Course
Admin --> UC_Sem

Admin --> UC_Enroll
Admin --> UC_Drop

Admin --> UC_AttRpt
Admin --> UC_GateAtt
Admin --> UC_Override

Admin --> UC_FeeStr
Admin --> UC_Voucher
Admin --> UC_Payment

Admin --> UC_Gates
Admin --> UC_Sched
Admin --> UC_Scanner

Admin --> UC_Ann

Admin --> UC_Analytics
Admin --> UC_Leader

Admin --> UC_FAQ
Admin --> UC_Keys

' ── Include / Extend ─────────────────────────────
UC_Voucher .> UC_FeeStr : <<include>>
UC_Payment .> UC_Voucher : <<include>>
UC_Scanner .> UC_Override : <<extend>>
UC_Leader .> UC_Analytics : <<extend>>

@enduml",
 "format": "svg"
}" id="14pVjtuajESJFR7WagT--20"> <mxCell parent="1" style="shape=image;noLabel=1;verticalAlign=top;aspect=fixed;imageAspect=0;image=data:image/svg+xml,;" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="2177" width="413" x="20" y="1100" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </UserObject> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
